evals.expected_output: Runs style-maintain on alpha.yaml; output includes all contract fields: fidelity metrics (N/M), exact-parity metrics (embedded-core styles only), SQI delta, authority basis, divergence statement, Code Opportunities table, QA verdict, research value rating.
assertions: Fidelity metrics in N/M format present (citations and bibliography)
SQI delta present (+N, -N, or ±0)
Authority basis stated (style guide / Citum policy / biblatex / citeproc / mixed)
Divergence field present (none, div-ID, or 'new adjudication required')
Code Opportunities table present with at least one row
Code Opportunities table Description column is not blank or all-dashes (real content or 'no opportunities observed')
QA verdict present (pass or fail with reason)
Research value rating present (high / medium / low)
Commit field present (short SHA + message, or 'none' if QA did not pass)
Routed-to sub-skill stated in output header

evals.expected_output: Identifies migrate mode from .csl path, routes to style-migrate-enhance, does not ask user to confirm mode.
assertions: Mode identified as migrate (not upgrade or create)
Output header states 'Routed to: style-migrate-enhance'
Did not ask user to confirm mode
Fidelity metrics in N/M format present
Code Opportunities table present with non-empty Description column

evals.expected_output: Even if no code opportunities found, the Co-Evolution table is present with at least a 'no opportunities observed' row — never omitted.
assertions: Code Opportunities table present
Table Description column contains real text (not blank or all-dashes) — 'no opportunities observed' is acceptable, bare dashes are not
Table has Description, Type, Action, Unlocks columns

evals.expected_output: Checks DIVERGENCE_REGISTER.md before classifying any oracle failure. Final output records exactly one of: 'applied divergence: div-XXX', 'no applicable divergence found', or 'new adjudication required'.
assertions: Divergence preflight evidenced in output (register checked before classifying failures)
Final output records exactly one divergence outcome: 'applied divergence', 'no applicable divergence found', or 'new adjudication required'
No oracle failure classified as a bug without a divergence register check

evals.expected_output: Completes full pipeline autonomously. Does not stop mid-task to ask questions. Commits automatically after QA pass. Does not end with 'what should I do next?'
assertions: Does not ask user for approval mid-task (outside explicit permission gates)
Commits automatically after QA pass
Final message does not end with an open-ended question to the user

evals.prompt: /style-evolve upgrade crates/citum-schema-style/embedded/styles/chicago-shortened-notes-bibliography.yaml, but the registered coverage packet has a stale style-chain hash
evals.expected_output: Reports coverage audit status 'stale', rejects the packet as invalid evidence, and stops style editing until the packet is regenerated. A high or changed uncovered count is not used as the reason for rejection.
assertions: Coverage-audit status is exactly 'stale'
Style editing stops until the registered packet is regenerated and validates
Rejection is based on freshness or validity, not the uncovered count itself
Does not claim uncovered fields caused text mismatches

evals.prompt: /style-evolve tune chicago-shortened-notes-bibliography using its current registered coverage audit
evals.expected_output: Reports coverage audit status 'current', inspects the adjudication record, selects one bounded output cluster from stable observation groups, and reports disposition plus joined exact-parity deltas after regeneration.
assertions: Coverage-audit status is exactly 'current'
One bounded output cluster is selected before editing
Stable observation IDs are cited for the selected cluster
Uncovered observations are described as investigation leads rather than proven causes
Final output includes render-disposition and joined exact-parity deltas

evals.prompt: /style-evolve migrate styles-legacy/chicago-shortened-notes-bibliography.csl; the only suspected converter evidence is the registered hand-authored Chicago coverage audit
evals.expected_output: Does not attribute the cluster to citum-migrate from the hand-authored audit. Requires a fresh migrated candidate from the CSL source and an apples-to-apples reproduction before reporting a converter defect.
assertions: Does not classify the hand-authored audit finding as a citum-migrate defect
Requires a fresh candidate generated from the relevant CSL source
Requires apples-to-apples reproduction of the bounded cluster
Reports coverage-audit status as current, stale, or not registered
